summary: Add typed receipt-mirror.check-quick observations to the protected evidence signing API, without granting command-execution or gate authority.

schema.detail: Evidence statements accept receipt_mirror with receipt_sha256, host, head, tree, passed/failed outcome, and mandatory no_execution claim.

rules.detail: Receipt mirrors never satisfy execution evidence policy.

compatibility.detail: New receipt mirrors use only tree-prefixed notes refs. Older readers ignore this new observation kind; tests and reviews retain their existing format.
